description: Source code for a Python script that generates C code for test modules, including classes for handling templates, parsing test functions, and managing test suites.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a test module, capable of parsing test functions, rendering templates, and managing callbacks, initializers, and cleanup functions.

classes.name: TestSuite
classes.description: Manages a collection of modules, handles loading, caching, enabling/disabling modules, and writing the generated code output.

methods.name: Module.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a Module instance with a name.

methods.name: Module.clean_name
methods.description: Converts underscores in the module name to double colons.

methods.name: Module._skip_comments
methods.description: Removes comments from C code content.

methods.name: Module.parse
methods.description: Parses test function definitions from code content.

methods.name: Module.refresh
methods.description: Refreshes module data from a file, re-parsing if modified.

methods.name: TestSuite.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a TestSuite with a path and output directory.

methods.name: TestSuite.should_generate
methods.description: Determines if the output should be regenerated based on module modifications.

methods.name: TestSuite.find_modules
methods.description: Finds and returns test modules in the specified path.

methods.name: TestSuite.save_cache
methods.description: Saves current module data to cache.

methods.name: TestSuite.suite_count
methods.description: Returns the count of test suites.

methods.name: TestSuite.callback_count
methods.description: Returns the total number of callbacks.

methods.name: TestSuite.write
methods.description: Generates and writes the output code for the test suite.
